aboutBody: Good connectivity is invisible. Getting there takes careful cable runs, sensible configuration and someone willing to explain the trade-offs. That is the job we set out to do.
We cover the full path: fiber and wireless links, routing and switching, Wi-Fi, cameras and the everyday IT that sits on top. One partner, one conversation.
Every engagement ends with a handover you can actually use: what was installed, how it is configured, and how to reach us.

whyChoose.title: Hands on the hardware
whyChoose.body: The people who plan your network are the ones who crimp, splice and configure it.

whyChoose.title: Plain-language explanations
whyChoose.body: You will know what was installed, why, and what to do if something changes.

whyChoose.title: Documented handover
whyChoose.body: Credentials, port maps and config notes are handed over, not kept hostage.

whyChoose.title: Right-sized, not oversold
whyChoose.body: We recommend what the site needs today, with a clear path for growth.

faq.title: How fast will you respond?
faq.body: We review requests personally. Response times depend on volume and location and are confirmed when we reply.

faq.title: Do you work on equipment you did not install?
faq.body: Yes. Inherited routers, switches and MikroTik setups are common. Share models and symptoms if you can.

faq.title: What should I include in a support request?
faq.body: Your location, what changed, when it started, which devices are affected and any error lights or messages.

faq.title: Is pricing fixed?
faq.body: Pricing depends on scope and site conditions. We confirm costs with you before any work begins.

privacy.title: Information you send us
privacy.body: When you submit an inquiry we receive the details you enter: name, email, optional phone and location, the service you select, your message and your consent confirmation.

privacy.title: Why we use it
privacy.body: Only to review and respond to your request, follow up on that request, and keep a record of the conversation. We do not sell inquiry details.

privacy.title: Spam protection
privacy.body: The form uses a short-lived security token and a hidden field to filter automated submissions. Basic technical request data may be processed by the server to operate and protect the site.

privacy.title: Storage and retention
privacy.body: Inquiry records are stored by the systems that run this website. Specific retention periods have not yet been finalised and will be stated here once set.

privacy.title: Your choices
privacy.body: You can ask us to access, correct or delete the details you submitted by sending a request through the inquiry form and quoting your reference number.

privacy.title: Administrative security
privacy.body: Administrative access is restricted. Authentication uses secure session cookies and technical security records to protect the corporate website.

privacy.title: Changes
privacy.body: This notice will be updated as our operations are formalised. The current version on this page applies.

terms.title: Using this site
terms.body: This website provides general information about our networking, Wi-Fi, fiber, security and IT services. Please use it lawfully and do not attempt to disrupt it.

terms.title: Inquiries are not contracts
terms.body: Submitting a request does not create a service agreement. Scope, pricing, schedule and any warranties are agreed separately in writing before work begins.

terms.title: Information on the site
terms.body: Service descriptions are general and may change. Sample portfolio images are illustrative and do not depict completed client projects.

terms.title: Coverage
terms.body: Listed coverage areas, where shown, are indicative. Availability is confirmed for each site individually.

terms.title: Third-party links
terms.body: Where external channels such as WhatsApp are offered, their own terms and privacy practices apply.

terms.title: Changes
terms.body: These terms may be revised. The version published on this page applies to your use of the site.
